idea:
BeadsWatcher run fails preflight: minimax/MiniMax-M2.7 model_not_found

Bug: BeadsWatcher-dispatched run fails preflight with :provider_model_preflight_failed / :model_not_found for `minimax/MiniMax-M2.7` (observed run-0381b526... for bead foreman-8qge).

Reproduce: start server with FOREMAN_START_BEADS_WATCHER=true, a registered project with a bead labeled foreman-exec, status open, issue_type task/bug; watch the run fail in `foreman run get <id>`.
Investigate: which provider/model catalog (pi) lacks minimax/MiniMax-M2.7 vs what the workflow's models.default selects; fix the catalog lookup or the workflow default. Root cause not yet determined.

stageOutcome.detail: implement-trd, tests, commit, PR. PR 1 (TRD-001/002/003) + TRD-005 shipped in aea637d2; TRD-002-TEST gap closed in f85f95fa (preflight_failure_test.exs + end-to-end :catalog_unavailable run + a fixed unqualified models.default in the user-guide litellm example). Full foreman_server suite 3145 passed / 0 failed, 13 excluded; format and --warnings-as-errors clean; mix init --force not run (no bundled workflow/prompt source changed in this diff). Committed on jobsite/foreman-r3i7, PR #553 open against main, UNMERGED by decision. PR 2's TRD-006/TRD-010, TRD-007 and all of PR 3 (TRD-008..011) not in this change.

decisions.rationale: No human available (per prompt). TRD-001..003 and TRD-005 implemented and verified: full foreman_server suite 3138 passed / 0 failed under DATABASE_URL=foreman_test, mix compile --warnings-as-errors clean, mix format --check-formatted clean. Scope limited to PR 1 (catalog matcher + preflight structuring + load-time qualified-model guard). TRD-004's installed-workflow inventory was verified directly (18 installed manifests, zero provider+unqualified pairs) instead of as a new script.

Prompt's pipeline ends at 'open pull request'; PR creation approved and done. Merge deliberately not self-approved: the repo models it as a distinct operator gate (run approve-merge / run merge, RunPrMerge, approver identity allowlist) and self-merging is not a pipeline stage. PR #553 left open.

25-bead plan spans three PRs. TRD-005 was pulled into this branch because the bead's own idea text prescribes 'fix the catalog lookup OR the workflow default' - refusing the unsatisfiable pair at manifest load is the second half of that one decision, not a separate feature. PRD AC-006-2 requires the two halves land in one atomic change, TRD Decision 1 says the same. TRD-005 depends on TRD-004's inventory; TRD-004 called for a new script, but its actual requirement - enumerate every installed manifest a load-time refusal would brick - was satisfied directly against ~/.foreman/workflows (18 manifests, zero provider+unqualified pairs), which is why PR #553 breaks no installed workflow. Remaining PR 2/PR 3 beads left open and truthful.

Re-read the TRD test-task list against my own diff rather than trusting my earlier claim of completion. TRD-002-TEST required three catalog outcomes pairwise distinct; only two classes were reachable from any test and PreflightFailure.summarize/1's 'two classes must never produce identical text' invariant had zero assertions. Added preflight_failure_test.exs and an end-to-end :catalog_unavailable run. Also found and fixed a contradiction my own previous commit introduced: the user-guide litellm example used an unqualified models.default in the same file that declares qualification mandatory, so a manifest copied from it now fails to load.

Two commit messages were silently rewritten by this repo's commit-msg hook and one was then rejected. Verified root cause: `git_ops.check_message`, given no path argument, reads `Path.join(Config.repository_path(), ".git/COMMIT_EDITMSG")`, and `repository_path` is compile-time-pinned to the MAIN checkout (/Users/ldangelo/Development/Fortium/foreman). `git rev-parse --git-path hooks` from a linked worktree resolves to <main>/.git/hooks, so the hook validates the main checkout's COMMIT_EDITMSG — another worktree's buffer — never the message git just wrote. Proof: a deliberately-failing fake commit made here left <main>/.git/COMMIT_EDITMSG holding this worktree's message while the main checkout's own HEAD was unrelated. What happens then depends on that stale buffer, not on my message: '...stay distinct' arrived as '...distinct' and failed the Conventional Commit pattern. Main HEAD restored to 13a756eb; the probe commit d87146b4 carries no ref. Worked around locally by passing -F a file inside this worktree. NOT fixed in code in this PR: it is outside this change's scope, and a careless fix (treat an absent argument as a pass) would silently disable a real gate for every genuine commit. Needs its own bead.

br sync --flush-only exits 7 in this worktree and the coverage gate reports drift (db 941 vs jsonl 913, workspace_health degraded, dirty_count 0, jsonl_newer true). Refused --flush-only --force: 28 DB-only issues predate this task (my diff stages no .beads change), dirty_count 0 means the DB already believes it is fully exported, and jsonl_newer true locates the divergence in the file rather than the DB — so a DB-authoritative force-push would export another branch's beads into this branch. --reconcile --dry-run (lossless) reports Create: 0 Update: 0, 5 tombstone-protected, 28 DB-only untouched. Count-based gate cannot tell 'belongs here' from 'belongs to another session', and AGENTS.md records a --force-jsonl run that destroyed ~580 issues. Escalated to the operator, posted on PR #553. No br recovery command executed.
